label: Non-concrete-priority rival of the simple-priority bridge survives, checked
description: Rival test for the simple-priority bridge against its smallest consumer, NecessaryFirstBeing.necessaryFirst (premises: concrete population, whole-roster nontrapping, contingent dependence, excluded middle, the simple-priority bridge). With a non-concrete item simply prior to the one necessary concrete root, the rival holds with the other four premises and that root is not a first being. Model-witnessed survival only.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.abstractPrior at its one world with abstractPriorTo: the rival, concrete population, WholeRosterNotTrapped, EveryContingentGroundedAt and excluded middle hold; NecessaryActualFirstAt fails. Consumer tested: NecessaryFirstBeing.necessaryFirst.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Profile, selected world and PriorSimply as the premise; one world, two candidates.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation; contingent dependence holds vacuously there.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one Profile, world and PriorSimply (unregistered helper abstractPrior_excludes).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.abstractPrior in Control.AbstractPriorSurvives; abstractPriorSurvives proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against act-is-simply-prior-to-potency and the adopted sense of concrete: what is simply prior would have to be in act, hence have esse in re.
